note: Voice Forge cast (tools/voice_forge/README.md). speaker id (Speakers.TABLE / Events.dialogue) -> Kokoro v1.0 voice + speed. voice = an id (af_/am_ American F/M, bf_/bm_ British F/M) or a blend {id: weight}. lang defaults from the prefix (b* = en-gb). Changing voice or speed re-renders that speaker's lines on the next build. `audition` = the candidates rendered by `run_voice_forge.ps1 audition` (docs/tools/voice_forge/auditions/). Cast approved by JS 2026-09-27 (Malrik = bm_george, heard and liked).
audition_line: The crown is not lost. It is only waiting for the right hands.

vessa.notes: Fire, young American woman: quick, bright, impatient. Speed 1.12 keeps most mission lines inside the 5 s dialogue box.
vessa.audition_line: Three braziers, one seal. How hard can it be to light things?

malrik.notes: Shadow, deep British man. bm_george chosen by JS. Speed 1.05: 0.9 overran most Ep3 slots in the first comparison, 1.0 still overran 4 of 15.
malrik.audition_line: Light all the candles you like. The dark just gets a better view.

torvald.notes: Ice, older British man: slow, weary, patient.
torvald.audition_line: A hundred winters I have kept this gate. I can keep it one more.

ysolde.notes: Nature, young British woman: calm, warm, stubborn.
ysolde.audition_line: Slow is how an oak outlives an army.

vey.notes: Old Vey, the Storm-Sword: old British man, gravel and humour. A daniel / lewis blend at 0.85 (older and slower than Torvald's plain lewis, 99 Hz).
vey.audition_line: Lightning? I have been struck since before you were born, girl.

torren.notes: Same man as Vey (Speakers.TABLE alias): shares Vey's voice and folder.

hush.notes: Mother Hush: American, low woman's voice (Malrik's helper). af_alloy measured the lowest pitch of the three (150 Hz); af_nicole (a slow whisper, 11 ch/s) is the alternative.
hush.audition_line: Hush now. The dark only wants to be listened to.

narrator.notes: Narrator: warm American man, unhurried storyteller; American so he never sounds like one of the British wizards.
narrator.audition_line: The Master is gone. His crown is not.

pell.notes: Pell the Ruin Peddler: quick, cheerful American merchant.
pell.audition_line: Buy something, would you? Shadow soldiers are terrible customers.

shade.notes: Shade (Shadow soldier, watch_keep cine): low, flat American man.
shade.audition_line: The keep sleeps. So should you.

whisper.notes: The Whisper (Obren's heart-stone, shown as ???): a slow half-Malrik blend, so the stone sounds like it borrows his voice.
whisper.audition_line: Let me in. I only want to help you win.

obren.notes: The Whisper once revealed: same voice.

master.notes: The Master (God Wizard), in memories: old, kind British storyteller.

ashby.audition_line: Hold the line until the horn.

bettany.notes: Bettany Crook: American woman, dry and practical.

maelis.notes: Maelis Oakenhollow (Ysolde's helper): British woman, older than Ysolde.
maelis.audition_line: The roots remember what the branches forget.
